name: iv_en_followup_v1
body:
Hi {{1}}, a short follow-up from IV Infotech, Mehsana. Earlier we sent a short video about automatic WhatsApp replies for {{2}}.

If someone taps the WhatsApp button on a {{2}} ad late in the evening, an automatic first reply can go out while your team is offline.

Want to see it for {{2}}? Tap "Yes, send the demo" below.
